criteria.description: Covered L1 reads use strict hash-pinned coherent observations and configured witness agreement; trading depth and timely terminal stop policy remain explicit. Meaningful RPC and real transport positive/negative cases pass.

Actual source-bound gateway binary passes authorize/recovery/cancel across pre-body, response-withheld and received-success SIGKILL/restart boundaries using encrypted disposable state; no false confirmed result or duplicate application.

Actual production event paths for HELD, persistence failure and deposit halt deliver redacted events to an owned local collector, with bounded transport, deduplication and verified recovery/rearm without weakening application safety.

Combined implementation is independently reviewed and relevant integrated checks pass with current source identities. Desktop work and all original task criteria/dependencies are preserved; proof, funds and release limits remain explicit.
